issues.title: flow-long-input.js was 8,411 LOC — extraction to sub-modules complete, now 1,103 LOC
issues.description: Extraction into sub-modules (flow-long-input-*.js) is complete. Main file reduced from 8,411 to 1,103 LOC. Passes, contradictions, association, chunking, complexity, constants, detection, language, parsing extracted to separate modules.

issues.title: flow-orchestrate.js reduced from 3,203 to 1,690 LOC — partial extraction done
issues.description: Originally 3,203 LOC with 6 embedded classes. Reduced to 1,690 LOC via extraction. Some classes (ProjectContextGenerator, TemplateEngine, RollbackManager, StateManager, Validator) may still benefit from further modularization.

issues.title: flow-done.js split into flow-done-gates.js and flow-done-report.js
issues.description: Originally 2,053 LOC. Split complete: flow-done.js (953 LOC), flow-done-gates.js (786 LOC), flow-done-report.js (124 LOC). Coordinator pattern now clean.

issues.title: flow-durable-session.js is 1,802 LOC / 53 functions — multiple responsibilities
issues.description: Candidate for splitting into flow-durable-session-core.js (step state), flow-durable-suspension.js, and flow-durable-history.js.

issues.title: flow-utils.js is 1,748 LOC — facade refactoring half-done, 70+ exports remain
issues.description: Task ID generation, ready.json CRUD, request log management, git utilities, and AST-grep integration should be extracted to focused modules.

issues.title: session-start.js entry hook contains business logic (283 LOC)
issues.description: CLAUDE.md drift detection logic (30+ LOC) belongs in a core/ module, not the entry hook.

issues.title: 9 learning modules with overlapping storage targets
issues.description: flow-failure-learning, flow-session-learning, flow-adaptive-learning, flow-auto-learn, flow-loop-retry-learning, flow-tiered-learning, flow-skill-learn, flow-standards-learner, flow-learning-orchestrator have overlapping writes to feedback-patterns.md and decisions.md. Learning writes now centralized through orchestrator, but modules still exist as separate files.

issues.title: Deprecated hybrid-session code paths — resolved via orchestrate.js extraction
issues.description: StateManager.updateHybridSession() deprecation warnings and legacy code paths were cleaned up as part of flow-orchestrate.js extraction (3,203 → 1,690 LOC).

issues.title: flow-damage-control.js promptHook — pattern-matching only, AI stub removed
issues.description: evaluatePromptWithAI() stub removed. promptHook feature documented as pattern-matching-only protection. AI-based prompt analysis is out of scope for the damage control system.

issues.title: 238 flow-*.js files in flat scripts/ directory
issues.description: Consider subdirectory grouping (scripts/memory/, scripts/context/, scripts/session/) for discoverability. Deferred to major version to avoid breaking require paths.
